title: EvaluateResponse
description: The engine's verdict on an experiment, with the numbers behind it.

reason.description: One sentence a person can read.

status.description: holds: within tolerance. moved: the estimate is past the tolerance but the interval is not. broke: the whole interval is past it. unknown: not enough data.

driver_adapted.description: True when a driver-input channel shifted between the setups: the effect may be the driver, not the car.

passes_excluded.description: Passes left out: missing the primary channel, plus those core excluded (setup or driver mismatch). Off-track passes are counted in the offtrack_rate guardrail instead.

finding_class.description: What the experiment found on the primary channel (ADR 0029), orthogonal to the decision: invalid, confirmed improvement or regression (the whole interval beyond the margin, at least 8 blocks), neutral (the interval inside the margin), context-dependent (the effect differs between speed regimes or corner phases), likely improvement or regression (the interval excludes zero), insufficient evidence.

flags.description: few_blocks: fewer than 8 blocks, never a confirmed finding. uninformative: the interval is more than twice the margin wide on each side.

recommendation.description: What to do next (ADR 0029): continue to the next look, test a larger step, investigate a speed regime or phase, switch the primary metric (time neutral or unclear, an expected response channel moved), stop (nothing to gain), stop (invalid). Absent when the finding is confirmed.

look.description: The look this verdict was judged at (ADR 0029).

margin.description: Margin of practical equivalence the finding was judged against, in the primary channel's unit.

engine_version.description: Version of the engine that computed the numbers (ADR 0030).

responses.description: The vehicle-response finding per cell the changed parameter is expected to move (ADR 0034), separate from the time finding. Cells it is not expected to move are not judged here (POST /response describes them).

response_parameter.description: The parameter row of the observables mapping the expected cells came from.

response_notes.description: Why the response findings are missing or what to read them with.

ChannelResult.title: ChannelResult
ChannelResult.description: The variant's effect on one channel: variant minus baseline per corner pass.

corner_class.description: all, or the speed class the estimate is restricted to.

Confounder.title: Confounder
Confounder.description: Something besides the setup that may be in the number, named for the reader.

name.description: The covariate, channel, speed classes, phases or reason it is about.

ResponseFinding.title: ResponseFinding
ResponseFinding.description: Variant minus baseline on one expected (metric, phase, speed regime) cell, block-level interval at the success test's level.

regime.title: ResponseRegime
regime.description: Speed regime of the corners, per corner and frozen from the baseline (ADR 0031).

expected.title: ResponseExpected
expected.description: direct: a measurement the parameter is expected to move; proxy: a stand-in for one.

finding.title: ResponseFindingClass
finding.description: What the car did on this cell (ADR 0034), judged against the metric's margin with Holm across the parameter's expected cells: increase or decrease (moved after Holm, the whole interval beyond the margin, at least 8 blocks), neutral (the interval inside the margin), likely increase or decrease (moved after Holm, not by the margin), insufficient (otherwise).

margin.description: From config/margins.toml: the item's own, else the metric's.
